summary: Accepted both PRINCIPAL019 candidates after actual distinct review and preserved frozen inputs. The P2 clarification defines individual principal/nonprincipal central pieces on the signed lift about zero; only the total is torus-periodic, and the existing rescaling/constants are unchanged. Exact actual-input comparison squares, central asymptotic coefficient2 J_eta/9, paid nonprincipal tails and the specific fractional lower bound remain supported. An immediate support corollary uses an allowed eta below71/32: exact raw geometry forces C1=Qraw=0 while the reviewed positive central term makes Qraw-Qmajor at most -c HY/(V_H^2 log^4 H). This refutes only the literal all-A per-block polynomial-input difference extension, not the accepted small-sift theorem or every corrected mechanism. No new load-bearing estimate, experiment, source search, extra round or unaccepted later-stage input was used. Prime-pair positivity, the original margin, novelty, breakthrough classification and Goldbach remain unestablished. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: The reviewed actual-input character/residue-square identities prove full comparison positivity and monotonicity, under the independent-label, H-unit and verified Psi-plateau hypotheses, without generic kernel PSD.

The individual central character pieces are defined on the signed lift [-Lambda/Y,Lambda/Y]; the total is periodic although individual pieces need not be. The exact rescaling and coefficient2 J_eta/9 are unchanged.

The accepted018 nonprincipal estimate with paid Mellin/tail costs and effective-PNT principal density give the central asymptotic and the positive lower bound for this specific actual fractional comparison.

The literal all-A per-block raw-minus-major extension to every allowed changed polynomial input is refuted. For a nonzero eta compactly supported in (33/16,35/16), raw support requires a/Y>=71/32 and is therefore empty, while Qmajor>=Q0>c HY/(V_H^2 log^4 H); any A>4 contradicts the proposed error scale.

The support corollary does not refute accepted small-sift results or all corrected polynomial mechanisms. Pointwise raw nonemptiness for general cutoffs, a revised original-target comparison/TypeI chain, other-k transport, the original prime margin, novelty, breakthrough classification and Goldbach remain unestablished.
